activity_summary: In the garden at dusk you said the fire was being given a reason, as the riot had been. You kept the sentence from March. It falls on them. You have not changed it.

facets.activity: Kept the March sentence that it falls on them

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: Everybody has the reason for it by Sunday

quotes.speaker: william_shakespeare
quotes.text: I think it falls on them. I wrote that in March
